Science, Storytelling, and Building New Worlds (and Cats) with Dr. Moiya McTier

Planetary Pandemonium
05-08-2026 • 33 minutos
Astrophysicist, folklorist, author, and science communicator Dr. Moiya McTier has built a career at the intersection of science and storytelling. In this episode of Planetary Pandemonium , Beth sits down with Moiya to talk about her journey into astronomy, how science fiction has influenced her life and career, and why telling better stories about science matters.
The conversation ranges from astrophysics and mythology to communication and the importance of making science welcoming to everyone. Along the way, Moiya shares the books and stories that inspired her, discusses her own writing, and introduces us to the furry companions who keep her company when she is away from the stars.
If you've ever wondered how someone combines science, folklore, and storytelling into one fascinating career, this episode is for you.

url_citation.content:
I’ve been selling on Amazon for over 8 years, always proudly maintaining 5 Star ratings, but now I see the new ‘Global Ratings’ that are popping up all over on Amazon listings within the past few

...

Yet I received another 20 ‘Global Ratings’ in the past few weeks and several of them are 4, 3, and 2 star ratings?

...

Yet in my search, now I only show up as having a 4.5 star rating for that product? Not to mention my sales for that product have gone from around 40 a month to maybe 4 per month since the Global Ratings have shown up on that listing.
I only sell on my own company website and Amazon. I do not sell globally and I have no review option set up on my company website, so does anyone know where these ‘Global Reviews’ are coming from? Is this Amazons way of turning buyers away from third party sellers who have a high rating for their product so customers buy from Amazon instead? It just seems so unfair, you do a good job but you get screwed by global reviews from people who didn’t even buy your product. If Amazon doesn’t want third party sellers on their site, just tell us instead of destroying the reputation of our products.
